about: The failure catalogue cc-failures records against: kind = <contract>/<symptom>, the broken contract and what was seen, never the guessed cause. Six to start (docs/design-failure-noticing-2026-09-11.md); it grows by use. `match` is a list of regexes over a board row's name: `cc-failures import` files a raised- row or an INSTANCE line under the first kind whose regex matches, else under the row's own family (board-row/<row>). A miss is a false split, a wrong hit a false match; `cc-failures metrics <fixture>` measures both.

answer-evidence/wrong-object-or-proxy.contract: an answer to a person rests on the record for the exact object it is about
answer-evidence/wrong-object-or-proxy.symptom: the answer rested on a proxy (a public read, a typed list, an empty output, an earlier case) and was wrong

gate-target/wrong-revision.contract: a gate runs on the revision it is reporting on
gate-target/wrong-revision.symptom: the gate ran on another tree or ref (a lagging fetch, a stale checkout, a copy) and its verdict was read as the branch's

guard-policy/permitted-text-refused.contract: the guard judges the command, and permits what the policy permits
guard-policy/permitted-text-refused.symptom: a permitted command was refused on words in its text (a heredoc body, a grep pattern, a path) and cost a turn

handoff-input/existing-record-not-found.contract: a session finds the record its predecessor left (a handoff, a journal, a ledger row)
handoff-input/existing-record-not-found.symptom: an existing record was reported absent, and the work restarted or the answer was wrong

notification/false-action-needed.contract: a wake or a nag names something a person or a seat must do
notification/false-action-needed.symptom: the authoritative state disproved it: nothing was needed, and the wake cost a context

mirror-freshness/publish-blocked.contract: the public mirror follows the default branch, and a publish that cannot run is noticed once
mirror-freshness/publish-blocked.symptom: the publish aborted and nothing reached the public repo; it kept aborting every tick and the mirror fell behind

failure-detection/person-first.contract: the box records its own failures before a person has to point at one
failure-detection/person-first.symptom: a person found a failure the box had not recorded; critical every time, and its record points at the episode

critical.false-claim-reached-owner: a false factual claim reached the owner
critical.approval-boundary: an approval boundary was crossed, or credibly may have been
critical.main-gate-or-deploy-red: a verified main gate or a deploy went red
critical.cap-fired: the runaway detector or an owner-set cap fired
critical.person-first: a person found a failure the box had not recorded
